jobs.title: BSA Officer / Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO)
jobs.desc: Designated BSA Officer / MLRO owning the full AML, CFT, OFAC and BSA program - SAR/CTR determinations, CIP/EDD, sanctions screening, FinCEN 314(a)/(b), and direct reporting to the CEO and Board. Sponsor-bank liaison. Fully remote, must reside in the US. 5+ yrs BSA/AML or MLRO experience. Up-and-coming crypto-card fintech. Re-verified active Sep 29. Realistic: asks 5+ yrs BSA/AML.

jobs.title: Director AML Compliance
jobs.desc: AML Compliance Officer over all money-movement products at a large payroll/HR fintech; runs the AML governance committee and KYC/customer due diligence framework. Fully remote US. Base $160K-$197.7K plus bonus and RSUs. Asks 10 yrs AML leadership and 5 yrs managing teams, so a stretch on years but squarely his KYC lane.

jobs.title: Vice President, BSA/AML Operations - Cases
jobs.desc: Operations leadership over Pathward's suspicious-activity case investigation function (BSA/AML, OCC expectations), a sponsor bank behind many fintech programs. Remote. Stretch: VP ops seat at his level, but case investigations rather than onboarding. Range runs well above $160K.

jobs.title: Director of Treasury & Financial Operations
jobs.desc: Hands-on director running recurring treasury and financial operations at a blockchain lending and capital-markets fintech. New York or Remote. Reach: asks 10 yrs in financial operations or treasury, which is adjacent to his investment-ops work.

jobs.title: Head of Compliance
jobs.desc: Scales enterprise compliance - financial crimes, payments, privacy and governance - at an instant-payments platform moving billions annually, and serves as the designated BSA/AML Compliance Officer. Leads an established team and reports to the COO. Remote, US only. $210K-$260K plus equity. Reach: designated BSA officer seat leading an established team.

jobs.title: Director of Compliance - US/CAN
jobs.desc: Builds and scales the global compliance function (including BSA/AML) as a high-growth B2B finance automation and payments company expands its payments ecosystem. Remote, United States / Canada. Reach: builds a global compliance function.

jobs.title: Head of Compliance
jobs.desc: Builds and leads the compliance function at a Sequoia/Multicoin-backed payments company (global payments, stablecoins, merchant-of-record model). Owns the program end to end: BSA/AML and financial crimes, licensing, regulatory exams, international expansion. United States - Remote. Reach: wants someone who has run a full compliance program.
